result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 wire/runtime source resolves the cancellation acknowledgement boundary. TaskAckResult serializes resultType=complete (optional _meta absent by default), and ServerResult::task_ack constructs it. Stock TaskManager::cancel_task mutates cancellation intent first: it resolves the task, sets cancel_requested=true, sends the cooperative signal, clears pending inputs for a nonterminal task, touches/recomputes status, then returns Ok(()). The source states the acknowledgement is immediate and the task can remain working until it settles. Combined with revision86 exact handler evidence that successful cancel_task maps to task_ack, an ack proves cancellation intent was accepted, not that the operation is terminal cancelled or that an external effect stopped. Authenticated-owner authorization must therefore happen before application cancellation, while terminal/effect safety remains separately unresolved.
